item.title: Payson community’s evacuation status for Bonita Fire lowered
item.description: A community near Payson that had been under a "GO" evacuation order due to the nearby Bonita Fire saw its status lowered to "SET."

item.title: US Olympians speaking up about politics at home face online backlash — including from Trump
item.description: Donald Trump on Sunday said that it is hard to cheer for American Olympians who are speaking out against administration policies, calling one such critic “a real Loser” who perhaps should have stayed home.
